server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Helps players distinguish servers with similar invite codes.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Leave empty to allow joining without a password.

invite_code.title: Invite Code
invite_code.description: Case-sensitive code with at least 6 letters or digits, used to find this server.

direct_connect_enabled.title: Enable Direct Connections
direct_connect_enabled.description: Accept direct client connections when enabled; otherwise use ICE peer-to-peer connections.

p2p_proxy_address.title: P2P Listen Address
p2p_proxy_address.description: Local IP address for P2P listening sockets. Leave empty to use Bind IP.

direct_connection_proxy_address.title: Direct Connection Listen Address
direct_connection_proxy_address.description: Selects the local network interface for direct connections. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces; leave empty to use Bind IP.

user_selected_region.title: Connection Service Region
user_selected_region.description: SEA, CIS, or EU (also covers North America). Leave empty to select a region by latency.

world_island_id.title: World Island ID
world_island_id.description: Exact existing world islandId. World parameters stay disabled until this matches one unambiguous RocksDB_v2 world folder and both native JSON identities.

world_name.title: World Name
world_name.description: Written to the selected existing WorldDescription.json as WorldName.

world_preset_type.title: World Preset
world_preset_type.description: Written as WorldPresetType. Official presets are Easy, Medium, and Hard; custom WorldSettings make the game force Custom on the next launch.

coop_quests.title: Shared Co-op Quests
coop_quests.description: Completing a co-op quest completes it for players who currently have it active.

easy_explore.title: Immersive Exploration
easy_explore.description: Legacy EasyExplore flag. Enabling it removes point-of-interest map markers and makes exploration harder.

mob_health_multiplier.title: Enemy Health Multiplier
mob_health_multiplier.description: Scales enemy health. Official range: 0.2 to 5.0.

mob_damage_multiplier.title: Enemy Damage Multiplier
mob_damage_multiplier.description: Scales damage dealt by enemies. Official range: 0.2 to 5.0.

ship_health_multiplier.title: Enemy Ship Health Multiplier
ship_health_multiplier.description: Scales enemy ship health. Official range: 0.4 to 5.0.

ship_damage_multiplier.title: Enemy Ship Damage Multiplier
ship_damage_multiplier.description: Scales damage dealt by enemy ships. Official range: 0.2 to 2.5.

boarding_difficulty_multiplier.title: Boarding Difficulty Multiplier
boarding_difficulty_multiplier.description: Scales the sailors that must be defeated in boarding actions. Official range: 0.2 to 5.0.

coop_stats_correction_modifier.title: Co-op Enemy Scaling
coop_stats_correction_modifier.description: Scales enemy health and posture loss by player count. Official range: 0.0 to 2.0.

coop_ship_stats_correction_modifier.title: Co-op Ship Scaling
coop_ship_stats_correction_modifier.description: Scales enemy ship health by player count. Official range: 0.0 to 2.0.

combat_difficulty.title: Combat Difficulty
combat_difficulty.description: Controls boss difficulty and general enemy aggression.

auto_load_latest_backup_if_has_broken.title: Auto-load Latest Backup
auto_load_latest_backup_if_has_broken.description: Written to ServerDescription.json as AutoLoadLatestBackupIfHasBroken. When enabled, Windrose tries to restore broken save files from backups during launch.

allow_multiple_server_instances.title: Allow Multiple Server Instances
allow_multiple_server_instances.description: Written to ServerDescription.json as CanLaunchMultipleServerInstances. Keep disabled unless each process uses an isolated Windrose database.
